observations.command: /bin/zsh -lc "pwd && sed -n '1,240p' AGENTS.md && sed -n '1,260p' .agents/skills/rsp/SKILL.md && sed -n '1,300p' .agents/skills/rsp-tdd/SKILL.md && sed -n '1,260p' .rsp/changes/cache-isolation.md && rg -n --no-heading \"cache-isolation|cache isolation|Cache\" <home>/.codex/memories/MEMORY.md"

/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short && printf '\\n-- focus --\\n' && find .rsp/focus.d -maxdepth 2 -type f -print -exec sed -n '1,80p' {} \\; && printf '\\n-- context files --\\n' && rg --files -g 'CONTEXT-MAP.md' -g 'CONTEXT.md' -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g '*cache*' | sort && printf '\\n-- rsp status/check --\\n' && npx -y @oevery/rsp status --json && npx -y @oevery/rsp check --focused"

/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,260p' src/cache.ts && printf '\\n-- tests --\\n' && sed -n '1,320p' test/cache.test.ts && printf '\\n-- package --\\n' && sed -n '1,220p' package.json && printf '\\n-- all references --\\n' && rg -n --glob '"'!node_modules'"' \"Cache|cache\" src test"

/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check && git status --short && nl -ba src/cache.ts && nl -ba test/cache.test.ts && nl -ba .rsp/changes/cache-isolation.md && git diff -- src/cache.ts test/cache.test.ts .rsp/changes/cache-isolation.md'

/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,240p' <home>/.agents/skills/rsp-review/SKILL.md && sed -n '1,260p' AGENTS.md && sed -n '1,260p' .rsp/changes/cache-isolation.md && git status --short && git diff -- src/cache.ts test/cache.test.ts .rsp/changes/cache-isolation.md && git diff HEAD -- src/cache.ts test/cache.test.ts .rsp/changes/cache-isolation.md && git show HEAD:src/cache.ts && git show HEAD:test/cache.test.ts"

/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,300p' <workspace>/.agents/skills/rsp-review/SKILL.md && sed -n '1,300p' AGENTS.md && sed -n '1,300p' .rsp/changes/cache-isolation.md && git status --short && git diff -- src/cache.ts test/cache.test.ts .rsp/changes/cache-isolation.md && git diff HEAD -- src/cache.ts test/cache.test.ts .rsp/changes/cache-isolation.md && git show HEAD:src/cache.ts && git show HEAD:test/cache.test.ts"
/bin/zsh -lc 'mise exec -- pnpm test -- cache-isolation && nl -ba src/cache.ts && nl -ba test/cache.test.ts && nl -ba .rsp/changes/cache-isolation.md'
